atoms.b: Social media platforms have transformed how teenagers communicate with their peers. ((++Generally)), young people can connect with friends across the globe instantly.
However, this digital connectivity comes with challenges. ((++In_fact)), cyberbullying has become a serious concern in schools worldwide.
((++Evidently)), many teenagers struggle with anxiety and low self-esteem due to constant comparison with curated online personas.
Research shows that excessive screen time ((++certainly)) affects sleep quality and academic performance.
((++In_short)), while social media offers opportunities for self-expression, it requires responsible usage and digital literacy.

atoms.b: The traffic had been unusually heavy all morning. ((++Obviously)), many people were heading to the same event.
((++Certainly)), reducing plastic consumption requires behavioural changes at both individual and societal levels.
((++Generally)), many people believe that recycling alone can solve the problem, but ((++in_fact)) we need to fundamentally rethink our production and consumption patterns.

atoms.b: ((++Apparently)), the rise of streaming services and recorded entertainment has fundamentally altered how people consume theatre, music, and comedy in the 21st century. Audiences now have access to professional performances from their homes, removing barriers of cost and travel.

((++Clearly)), live performance offers an experience that recorded media cannot fully replicate, for example the direct connection between performers and audience that creates a unique emotional impact.
((++Above_all)), supporting live artists and venues matters more than simply choosing the most convenient entertainment option.
((++Overall)), the future of live performance will depend on how venues demonstrate the distinctive value they offer compared to recorded media.

((++All_in_all)), while streaming entertainment has disrupted traditional performance venues, it has also created new opportunities for artists to reach global audiences, and has renewed interest in live events as people seek authentic experiences that screens cannot provide.
